title: Finite-stage and coefficient tower coherence laws
statement: Under the hypotheses of the adic ambient Hom evaluation comparison, the specified finite evaluation and comparison maps satisfy signed symmetry, finite evaluation and comparison squares, extension, tower, and identity laws.

source.place: BS Lemma 3.4.11 and Remark 6.8.15; second half of the retained seven-step argument

proof.text: Apply commonStageEvaluation_finiteSquare to the normalized source structure. Naturality of the specified realization tensorator and functoriality carry this source equality to the finite realized evaluation square.

Apply inverse ambient transposition to the finite comparison square. The two uncurries are equal by the finite evaluation square after precomposition with tensor(identity,gammaM.inv). Thus injectivity proves the comparison square for the actual evaluation-defined transposes.
The ambient comparison evaluation equation follows directly from inverse transposition. Naturality of the ambient braiding and the given symmetric tensorator equation prove signed symmetry.

Precompose the extension equation with gammaH at the first field, cancel its inverse, and apply the two finite comparison squares. Bifunctoriality and the gammaM/gammaN inverse identities give the required ambient transition. For tower and identity laws, functoriality and cancellation of adjacent gamma isomorphisms prove both conjuncts.

proof_origin.place: Step 7 of the retained ambient comparison; source finite-stage normalization isolated, remaining transpose, symmetry and tower calculations formalized by H4.
